paragraphs: By leveraging my experience in building machine learning pipelines and models, I can significantly contribute to Creditspring's mission of improving financial stability. I developed scikit-learn pipelines and LSTM/BiRNN/CNN models using TensorFlow/Keras, which were then deployed as FastAPI services in Docker. This not only enhanced our predictive capabilities but also streamlined the deployment process.

Additionally, I proposed and prototyped an MCP-based agentic tool in Python, utilizing FastMCP, Ollama gpt-oss:20b, PostgreSQL, and GitHub Actions CI. This tool was showcased in a live stakeholder demo, demonstrating its potential to drive innovation in financial services.
I have not used XGBoost yet, but I am eager to explore its capabilities in future projects.
